<details class="nhsuk-details">
<summary class="nhsuk-details__summary"><span class="nhsuk-details__summary-text">Text description of this diagram</span></summary>
<div class="nhsuk-details__text">

| Step | Where you are | What you do | What you produce |
|---|--------------|--------------------|--------------------|
| 1 | Business Critical analysis | Be named at scoping, before the analysis starts. | The register entry, with your name against it. |
| 2 | The Analysis Senior Responsible Officer | Risks across the lifecycle, and suitability for the intended use. | Nothing recorded yet. |
| 3 | Phase 1 Engagement and scoping | Confirm the Business Critical status, and the resources and plans for assurance. | Confirmed resources, and the register entry checked. |
| 4 | Phase 2 Design | Confirm design governance has been followed before the analysis starts. | Design governance confirmed, and recorded. |
| 5 | Phase 3 Analysis | Stay aware of progress, and be available to approve at delivery. | Nothing recorded. Your availability in the schedule. |
| 6 | Phase 4 Delivery, communication and sign-off | Approve it as fit for its intended use, before it is used. | Your approval, recorded with what you confirmed. |
| 7 | Phase 5 Review | Revalidate the designation annually, and before any reuse for a new purpose. | The revalidated designation, and the register updated. |

: The Analysis Senior Responsible Officer's journey, step by step

A second note, **after the last step:** What review finds is what the next revalidation starts from.

</div>
</details>
